scenarios.prompt: Player A (rating 1500) plays Player B (rating 1700). A wins. K-factor = 32. Compute the new ratings after this match. Report new_rating_a, new_rating_b, delta_a (the change in A's rating).

Player A (1850) draws against Player B (1620). K = 24. Common trap: agents often think a draw means no rating change. Wrong — the higher-rated player LOSES points on a draw because the expected score was > 0.5 and the actual was 0.5. Compute new_rating_a, new_rating_b, delta_a.

Two grandmasters: Player A (2400) loses to Player B (2100). The federation uses K = 16 for top players (lower K reduces volatility for established ratings). Compute new_rating_a, new_rating_b, delta_a.
